logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the Zn-DTS complex was determined by measuring the partition coefficient (PC) between n-octanol and Tris buffer. Twenty microliters of 10 mM Zn-DTS complex in DMSO was mixed with 2 mL each of n-octanol and 50 mM Tris–HCl buffer (pH 7.4) in a test tube. The test tubes were shaken repeatedly three times each mixing and standing for 1 min, followed by standing for 20 min. All treatments were replicated four times. Subsequently, the solutions were centrifuged at 3,000 × g for 5 min at room temperature. A 1 mL aliquot of each phase was removed, and the concentration of the Zn-DTS complex in each phase was calculated from ε obtained with the above-mentioned method.
